title: Figure 5: Complementary Media Invisibility Cloak – four-panel schematic
description: Four-panel schematic labeled a) to d). Panels a) and b) show a negative-index slab (ε' = -1, μ' = -1) between -L and L that cancels empty space and then an object paired with an antiobject (crescent shapes). Panels c) and d) show spherical shells with radii a, b and c in which an object in the canceled shell is cloaked. The caption begins "Figure 5. Complementary Media Invisibility Cloak."
